# Create eye-catching flyers in minutes with Meta AI

You don't need design experience to make a flyer that turns heads. Meta AI can generate a ready-to-print poster in seconds. By the end of this guide, you'll have a bright, clear flyer for your next community event — and you'll know how to tweak it any time.

## Before you start
- A free Meta AI account (sign up at [meta.ai](https://meta.ai) or use it through Facebook/Instagram messenger).
- A short description of your event (title, date, time, location, and one sentence about what people will do).
- A device with internet and a printer or a way to share the image (phone, tablet, or computer).
- Rough time: 10 minutes total.

---

## Step 1 — Open Meta AI and start a new image
Go to [meta.ai](https://meta.ai) on your computer or open Meta AI through Facebook Messenger or Instagram (look for the AI chat feature). You'll see a chat box at the bottom of the screen. Tap inside it or click to start typing.
💬 Example: Type or paste:
`Create a bright flyer for a community barbecue on Saturday 14 June from 11 am to 2 pm at Riverside Park. Include a big title, date, time, location, and a simple picture of a grill and people eating outdoors.`
You'll know it worked when the screen shows a generating indicator and a preview appears.

---

## Step 2 — Describe your flyer in plain words
Write a short sentence that tells Meta AI what you want. Be clear about the event, the date, the time, the place, and the main image you want. If you're not sure what to write, use the example above and change the details.
💬 Example: Replace the example with your own words, for instance:
`Make a flyer for a free family movie night on Friday 20 June at 7 pm in the local library garden. Add a big title, the date and time, the words "All welcome", and a simple picture of a projector and a crowd sitting on blankets.`
You'll know it worked when the preview changes to show your new flyer idea.

---

## Step 3 — Ask for a specific style
Add one or two words to set the style. Use words like "bright", "simple", "fun", "modern", or "cartoon". This helps Meta AI pick colors and shapes that look good together. If you're not sure, try "bright and simple".
💬 Example: Add to the end of your prompt:
`in a bright and simple style`
You'll know it worked when the image looks colorful and easy to read at a glance.

---

## Step 4 — Add visual text elements (if supported)
Meta AI can sometimes include text in generated images, but results vary — the AI may not always render letters clearly. For best results, describe what you want the text to look like rather than exact words, or plan to add text later in a design app.
💬 Example: Add to your prompt (with understanding that results may vary):
`with large readable text that says "Community Movie Night"`
You'll know it worked when the preview shows text-like elements on the flyer.

---

## Step 5 — Download or share your flyer
When the preview looks good, look for a download option — usually an arrow icon or a share menu (often found by tapping the three-dot menu on the image). Save the flyer to your device.
💬 Example: Tap the download option and choose where to save the file.
You'll know it worked when you see the flyer image in your photos or downloads folder.

---

## Step 6 — Print or share your flyer
Open the flyer image from your device and use your device's share function. Choose "Print" to print it, or pick an app like Messages, WhatsApp, or Facebook to share it with your community group.
💬 Example: Tap the share button and select "Print" or "Messages" to send it to a friend.
You'll know it worked when the flyer prints clearly or arrives in a chat as a picture.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Mistake:** The flyer looks blurry or stretched.
  **Fix:** Ask Meta AI to "keep the image square" or "use a high-resolution style" in your prompt.

- **Mistake:** The text is too small or hard to read.
  **Fix:** Say "large bold text" or "big readable letters" in your prompt before you generate the image.

- **Mistake:** The colors don't match your event.
  **Fix:** Add "in [your color] and bright colors" to your prompt, for example "in green and bright colors".

- **Mistake:** Text doesn't appear clearly in the generated image.
  **Fix:** Use a free design tool like Canva to add text on top of the generated image for clean, readable results.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** Make a flyer for a garage sale, a school fete, or a neighbourhood clean-up. Print a few copies and tape them to lamp posts or share them in local Facebook groups.

- **For your business or work:** Create a quick poster for a pop-up shop, a workshop, or a stall at a market. Change the text each week to keep customers coming back.

- **If you're just getting started:** Start with a simple prompt like the examples above. Once you see how easy it is, you can try adding your logo or changing the colors next time.

---

## Try it now
Open Meta AI, type this prompt, and press send:
`Create a bright flyer for a community book swap on Saturday 28 June from 10 am to 1 pm at the community centre. Include a big title, the date and time, the words "All books welcome", and a simple picture of books on a table.`
